summaries.body:
ASVS 5.0.0 V5.4.3 is carried forward from 4.0.3 V12.4.2 (modified, moved). The predecessor required that files from untrusted sources be scanned by antivirus scanners to prevent upload and serving of known malicious content. The current clause keeps antivirus scanning of untrusted files to prevent serving of known malicious content.

Mapping agrees with that move. Predecessor-lineage git includes jim's 2021-03-12/13 Files-Resources updates on V12.4.2. Compact lineage also attaches old V5.4.3 SSRF-move events (tghosth, 2019-01-13) and V12.3.x RFI/SSRF clarification (#798), which are other controls. Mapping and V12.4.2 are the reliable origin.

From 4.0.3 V12.4.2 the 5.0 text drops "upload and," so the attested duty is preventing serving of known malicious content rather than both upload and serving. Jim's March 2021 Files-Resources commits sit on the predecessor ID; they are not described beyond file updates and restoring labels.

Issue #798 (elarlang, 2020-05-30) and tghosth's clarifying commit are about V12.3.2/V12.3.3 RFI versus SSRF wording, not antivirus scanning. The 2019 SSRF-move on the V5.4.3 slot is the old chapter. Do not read those events as rewriting this scanner control.
